entry.name: menuStyle
entry.label: The Style card: windows7 | modern | windows10 | windows11 | windows12 | app | pro | launcher | xp | plasma (menu, taskbar and windows unless menuLook/taskbarLook/windowLook say otherwise)

entry.name: menuSize
entry.label: Size: 0 Small, 1 Tall, 2 Wide, 3 Large

entry.name: menuPosition
entry.label: Menu position (T42): 0 Left (at the Start button), 1 Center (Windows 11), 2 Right (layout mirrored)

entry.name: centerTaskbar
entry.label: With Center: also centre the Start button and the Task Manager icons (panel spacers, Task Manager fill off)

entry.name: menuHeight
entry.label: Custom menu height in px; 0 = from Size

entry.name: fullScreen
entry.label: UseFullScreenMenu: menu covers the whole screen

entry.name: keepPanelVisible
entry.label: SemiFull: full screen menu leaves the panel visible

entry.name: uiScale
entry.label: UISCALE: extra scale for the whole menu

entry.name: tileColumns
entry.label: TileColCount: medium tiles per group row (3-8)

entry.name: tileGap
entry.label: Space between tiles, px

entry.name: tileIconScale
entry.label: Tile icon size, percent of the tile

entry.name: hideTileText
entry.label: HideGridText

entry.name: tileGroups
entry.label: Tile pages as JSON: {pages: [{groups: [...]}]}

entry.name: tilePage
entry.label: Last shown tile page

entry.name: tilesLocked
entry.label: LockedIcons

entry.name: showRecentlyAdded
entry.label: RecentApps10

entry.name: showMostUsed
entry.label: Show most used apps

entry.name: categoryFolders
entry.label: Show app categories as folders in the list

entry.name: foldersAtBottom
entry.label: Place folders at the bottom of the list

entry.name: autoExpand
entry.label: AutoExpand: open folders in All Programs on hover

entry.name: desktopInTree
entry.label: DesktopInTree: show ~/Desktop as a folder in All Programs

entry.name: allAppsAsMenu
entry.label: AllAppsAsMenu: categories as a cascading menu

entry.name: highlightNew
entry.label: Highlight: mark newly installed apps

entry.name: hiddenApps
entry.label: ShowHidden: apps hidden from the lists (desktop ids)

entry.name: filteredFolders
entry.label: Filtered folders: JSON [{ name, path, include, exclude }] (regexes over file names)

entry.name: hideAppList
entry.label: HideAppsList: tiles only

entry.name: listIconSize
entry.label: IconsScale10: app list icons, px

entry.name: listRowHeight
entry.label: App list row height, px

entry.name: railMode
entry.label: RightIconMode: 0 icons only, 1 expand on hover, 2 always show names

entry.name: railIconSize
entry.label: Left side icons, px

entry.name: railItems
entry.label: Left side shortcuts, top to bottom. Built-in ids, or "custom|name|icon|target"

entry.name: powerItems
entry.label: Power menu entries (kicker SystemModel ids)

entry.name: railAlignBottom
entry.label: RightIconMode 3: rail icons at the bottom

entry.name: smallPlaces
entry.label: SmallRight: small place rows

entry.name: powerButtonIcon
entry.label: IconOnShutdownButton

entry.name: recentHideFolders
entry.label: Win11HideRecentFolders

entry.name: webFavicons
entry.label: Web links pinned to the start menu obtain the favicon image

entry.name: powerButtonAction
entry.label: PowerButtonMode: "menu" or a power id run on click

entry.name: pinnedGrid
entry.label: Pinned apps of the grid styles (Windows 11, App, Pro), in order

entry.name: pinnedCaptions
entry.label: Renamed pins as JSON: {id: name}

entry.name: pinnedColumns
entry.label: Pinned grid columns

entry.name: pinnedRows
entry.label: Pinned grid rows per page

entry.name: showRecommended
entry.label: Show the Recommended section

entry.name: recommendedRows
entry.label: Recommended rows (2 items per row)

entry.name: recommendedKinds
entry.label: 0 apps and files, 1 only files, 2 only apps

entry.name: bottomItems
entry.label: Shortcuts next to the power button (ids as in railItems)

entry.name: openAllApps
entry.label: OpenAllProgs11: open on the all apps list

entry.name: showSearchBox
entry.label: Show the search box (when off it appears while typing)

entry.name: win12ListSide
entry.label: Windows 12 app list side: 0 automatic (menu Left = list left, Centre/Right = list right), 1 left, 2 right

entry.name: win12Greeting
entry.label: Windows 12 greeting with the user picture: 0 automatic (on when the list is on the left), 1 on, 2 off

entry.name: win12Chips
entry.label: Windows 12 folder chips (Documents, Pictures, Music) above the cards

entry.name: win12Clock
entry.label: Windows 12 clock and date above the cards

entry.name: win7Substyle
entry.label: Win7StyleSub: 0 plain, 1 with icons, 2 compact, 3 grid, 4 grid with icons, 5 compact grid

entry.name: modernSubstyle
entry.label: ModernStyleSub: same numbers as win7Substyle

entry.name: xpSubstyle
entry.label: Windows XP style: luna (real XP, "Classic XP") | classic ("Modern classic") | modern (same colours, rounded)

entry.name: xpFirefoxTitlebar
entry.label: With an XP theme, use the system title bar in Firefox (user.js)

entry.name: xpIcons
entry.label: With the XP style, switch the icon theme to xpIconTheme (the user's one is saved in savedIconTheme)

entry.name: xpIconTheme
entry.label: Icon theme used with the XP style; empty = the first installed theme with "xp" in its folder or Name

entry.name: savedIconTheme
entry.label: Icon theme that was active before the XP icons; restored when they go off

entry.name: xpTaskbarTheme
entry.label: With the XP style, switch the Plasma Style (panel) to win12-xp-classic / win12-xp-modern

entry.name: windowTheme
entry.label: Apply the menu style's window decoration (Aurorae) and colour scheme (XP for now, see main.qml windowDecoration/windowColors). Changes all windows.

entry.name: windowOpacity
entry.label: T41: window frame opacity in percent (100 = solid); below 100 a deco is made at apply time

entry.name: windowBlur
entry.label: T41: blur behind a translucent window frame (turns on KWin's blur effect, see savedBlur)

entry.name: windowRadius
entry.label: T41: top window corner radius in px (-1 = the style's own, 0 = square)

entry.name: titleHeight
entry.label: T41: title bar height in px (0 = the style's own)

entry.name: windowImage
entry.label: W14: title bar picture, PNG/JPEG path; empty = none

entry.name: windowImageMode
entry.label: W14: title bar picture placement: stretch | tile

entry.name: windowImageAlpha
entry.label: W14: title bar picture opacity in percent (times the frame opacity)

entry.name: windowImageTint
entry.label: W14: tint the title bar picture with the accent colour (multiply)

entry.name: win10AccentStart
entry.label: Colours page (all styles but XP): show accent colour on Start and taskbar (menu = darkened accent, taskbar = accent)

entry.name: win10AccentTitles
entry.label: Colours page (all styles but XP): show accent colour on title bars and window borders (generated win12-win10|win11-*-accent-hex, win12-win7-accent-hex decoration/scheme)

entry.name: win10Transparency
entry.label: Colours page (all styles but XP): transparency effects (off = solid menu and taskbar)

entry.name: xpColor
entry.label: Windows XP colour scheme (menu + taskbar): blue | olive | silver | custom (from xpCustomColor)

entry.name: xpStartGreen
entry.label: With the XP style the panel Start button stays green (like XP); off = scheme colour

entry.name: xpStartCustom
entry.label: XP Start button uses xpStartColor (wins over xpStartGreen)

entry.name: taskbarTheme
entry.label: Generated taskbar Plasma Style for any menu style: off | custom (Start11 "Override taskbar colour"); XP taskbar wins

entry.name: taskbarHiding
entry.label: Taskbar auto-hide (panel.hiding): 0 off (the user's own value), 1 hide when a window covers it (dodgewindows), 2 always (autohide)

entry.name: taskbarFloating
entry.label: Windows 12 taskbar floats (the other taskbar styles never float)

entry.name: taskbarPopAnim
entry.label: Windows 12 auto-hidden taskbar pop-up animation (KWin effect win12panelpop): 0 Plasma slide only, 1 fade, 2 zoom, 3 rise

entry.name: win12Light
entry.label: W11 Windows 12 light background (taskbar, menu): 0 soft tint .. 100 near white; -1 = the default look

entry.name: win12Dark
entry.label: W11 Windows 12 dark background (taskbar, menu): 0 soft dark .. 100 near black; -1 = the default look

entry.name: win12Transparency
entry.label: W11 Windows 12 background see-through % (taskbar, menu, title bars); -1 = the default glass

entry.name: win12Blur
entry.label: W11 kwinrc [Effect-blur] BlurStrength (1-15) while a Windows 12 part is on; -1 = the user's own

entry.name: win12Noise
entry.label: kwinrc [Effect-blur] NoiseStrength (grain, 0-14) while a Windows 12 part is on; 0 = smooth glass

entry.name: win12ReadableGlass
entry.label: W18 Windows 12 readable glass: two-tone edge + shadow in the theme (edge=1) and the kwin-win12 squeeze keys

entry.name: taskbarGap
entry.label: W12 Windows 12 floating bar/islands: px between the bar and the screen edge (0 = touching)

entry.name: taskbarWindows
entry.label: W15 Windows 12 floating single bar: 0 = windows fill the screen (auto-hiding island), 1 = keep a gap above an always-visible island (docked panel, thicker by 2 x taskbarGap, ring theme)

entry.name: menuGap
entry.label: W12 Windows 12 menu: px between the taskbar and the Start menu popup

entry.name: taskbarLayout
entry.label: Windows 12 taskbar layout: single | split-left | split-right | islands (3 islands: pinned, open apps, tray)

entry.name: taskbarMagnetic
entry.label: Split layouts: islands sit close together, the group centred on the screen (off = pushed to the screen edges)

entry.name: islandScreen
entry.label: Spec 10 "Show islands on": empty = the main (primary) monitor, "all" = every monitor, else a connector name (HDMI-A-2)

entry.name: islandAllApps
entry.label: Spec 10 "Open apps on other monitors" (with islandScreen = all): false = a copy's task managers show only the windows on its monitor (stock showOnlyCurrentScreen), true = every window on every monitor

entry.name: menuLook
entry.label: T43 Start menu look, empty = same as menuStyle (the Style card); else a menuStyle id

entry.name: taskbarLook
entry.label: T43 taskbar preset look, empty = same as menuStyle; xp | windows7 | windows10 | windows11 | windows12. Off = taskbarFollowsStyle/xpTaskbarTheme false

entry.name: windowLook
entry.label: T43 window decoration look, empty = same as menuStyle; xp | windows7 | windows10 | windows11. Off = windowTheme false

entry.name: taskbarRound
entry.label: Windows 12 taskbar corners in percent of half the thickness (0 square, 100 pill)

entry.name: taskbarFollowsStyle
entry.label: Taskbar preset follows the menu style (Win10 dark square, Win11 light translucent, Win7 blue glass); replaces the custom keys

entry.name: taskbarColor
entry.label: Taskbar colour (Start11 CustomColourTaskbar)

entry.name: taskbarAlpha
entry.label: Taskbar opacity in percent (Start11 TaskbarAlphaValue)

entry.name: taskbarRadius
entry.label: Taskbar corner radius in px (Start11 rounded corners; 2 = square)

entry.name: taskbarLine
entry.label: Light line on the taskbar edge (off = Start11 HideTaskbarLineEntirely)

entry.name: taskbarButtons
entry.label: Taskbar button style in the generated taskbar: plasma | win10 | win11 | win7 (Start11 taskbar button style)

entry.name: taskbarFocusedSolid
entry.label: Active task button less transparent (Start11 "Paint focused item backgrounds less transparent")

entry.name: taskbarImage
entry.label: Taskbar texture, PNG/JPEG path (Start11 TaskbarImage); empty = none

entry.name: taskbarImageMode
entry.label: Texture placement: tile | stretch | top | middle | bottom (Start11 tile/stretch, CustomTextureAlignment)

entry.name: taskbarImageAlpha
entry.label: Texture opacity in percent (Start11 texture alpha)

entry.name: taskbarImageTint
entry.label: Tint the texture with the accent colour, multiply (Start11 accent tint)

entry.name: taskbarGradient
entry.label: W14: generated taskbar gradient: none | left-right | right-left | top-bottom | bottom-top

entry.name: taskbarGradientStrength
entry.label: W14: gradient end = the bar colour this % toward white (dark bar) or black (light bar)

entry.name: taskbarPins
entry.label: Custom pins (custom|...) also pinned to the taskbar (Start11 taskbar pins of files, folders, websites)

entry.name: taskbarSearch
entry.label: Search box next to the start button (Start11 "Show search on taskbar")

entry.name: taskbarSearchWidth
entry.label: Width of the taskbar search box, px

entry.name: savedDesktopTheme
entry.label: Plasma Style that was active before the XP / generated taskbar theme; restored when both are off

entry.name: savedDecoLibrary
entry.label: kwinrc [org.kde.kdecoration2] library before windowTheme; restored when it goes off

entry.name: savedBlur
entry.label: kwinrc [Plugins] blurEnabled before the T41 glass blur ("unset" = no key, "" = nothing saved); restored when it goes off

entry.name: savedDecoTheme
entry.label: kwinrc [org.kde.kdecoration2] theme before windowTheme; restored when it goes off

entry.name: savedColorScheme
entry.label: kdeglobals [General] ColorScheme before windowTheme; restored when it goes off

entry.name: canvasTab
entry.label: App canvas tab the menu opens on (0 Pinned, 1 Apps, 2 Recent, 3+ user tabs); set by "Always open on this tab"

entry.name: canvasLayout
entry.label: App canvas user tabs, JSON {tabs:[{name, groups:[{name, colour, ids}]}]}

entry.name: canvasTextures
entry.label: Draw the Start11 tab textures behind each canvas group

entry.name: colorMode
entry.label: 0 automatic (Plasma colours), 1 force dark, 2 force light, 3 custom

entry.name: accentMode
entry.label: Selected item accent colour: 0 Plasma accent, 1 custom

entry.name: recentAccents
entry.label: T39 Colours page: the last 5 picked accent colours (#rrggbb), newest first

entry.name: menuOpacity
entry.label: MenuAlphaValue, percent

entry.name: solidMenu
entry.label: SolidAlpha

entry.name: cornerRadius
entry.label: BlockRounded off when 0

entry.name: tileColorMode
entry.label: 0 soft (text colour), 1 accent colour, 2 custom

entry.name: tileOpacity
entry.label: TileAlphaValue, percent

entry.name: tileImage
entry.label: TileImage: absolute path of an image shown behind every tile; empty = none

entry.name: tileImageOpacity
entry.label: TileImage opacity, percent

entry.name: greyIcons
entry.label: Show app icons in grey

entry.name: animateMenu
entry.label: Fade the menu in when it opens (inverse of NoAnims)

entry.name: classicSearch
entry.label: Classic (Start10) search: dense one-line results, no Best match card

entry.name: texture
entry.label: BackgroundImage: file in images/MenuTextures, or an absolute path; empty = none

entry.name: textureMode
entry.label: 0 tile, 1 stretch (TextureForceStretch), 2 fit, 3 fill

entry.name: textureOpacity
entry.label: TextureAlphaValue, percent

entry.name: darkenTexture
entry.label: DarkenBackground

entry.name: colorizeTexture
entry.label: CustomColourTexture: tint the texture with the menu colour

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Menu font; empty = Plasma default

entry.name: fontSize
entry.label: CaptionFontSize, px

entry.name: headerFontFamily
entry.label: Header font (group names, letters, section titles)

entry.name: headerFontSize
entry.label: Header font size, px (0 = menu size)

entry.name: itemFontSize
entry.label: Item font size, px (0 = menu size)

entry.name: groupResults
entry.label: Group results by type (Apps, Files, Settings ...)

entry.name: searchRunners
entry.label: KRunner plugins to use; empty = all enabled ones

entry.name: showWebSearch
entry.label: Show search the internet button

entry.name: webSearchUrl
entry.label: %s is replaced by the search text

entry.name: searchFilterIcons
entry.label: Show filter icons above search results (Apps, Settings, Documents ...)

entry.name: searchHistoryEnabled
entry.label: Remember the last searches that were launched

entry.name: searchHistory
entry.label: Last 10 launched search queries, newest first

entry.name: searchFilter
entry.label: Last used search filter: "" (all), apps, settings, documents, music, pictures, videos, files, web

entry.name: buttonMode
entry.label: StartButtonMode: 0 image sheet, 1 four squares, 2 icon

entry.name: buttonImage
entry.label: File in images/StartButtons, or an absolute path

entry.name: buttonIcon
entry.label: Icon name or absolute path; empty = the KDE logo (start-here-kde); pick any icon or image in the settings

entry.name: buttonIconScale
entry.label: Icon size, percent of the panel height

entry.name: squaresAccent
entry.label: Colour of the top left square

entry.name: buttonMenuItems
entry.label: Start button right-click menu entries

entry.name: win12Mirror
entry.label: Set by islands.js on a Start copy made for another monitor: the main Start widget's id. A copy runs no island engine and touches no panel

entry.name: resetRequest
entry.label: Set by the settings pages: "positions", "all", "backup" or "restore" plus a timestamp (and file); main.qml does the reset and clears it

entry.name: openSettingsRequest
entry.label: Changed by the win12-settings command to open the settings window

entry.name: designRequest
entry.label: Changed by the Layout page's "Edit menu layout" button: opens the menu in design mode

entry.name: splits
entry.label: Design mode divider widths, JSON { "style" or "style/part": unscaled px }

entry.name: configMigrated
entry.label: Set once the old PlasmoidItem settings ([Configuration][*] groups) were copied to the containment's own groups

entry.name: explorerDefault
entry.label: Use Win12 Explorer as the file manager: inode/directory default, FileManager1, Start menu item and taskbar pin (win12-explorer-default on/off saves and restores the old default)

entry.name: explorerTagFlags
entry.label: Show tag flags on icons in Dolphin and Win12 Explorer (writes win12-explorerrc [Tags] showFlags)
